newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo precious metals market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo precious metals market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Tokyo precious metal futures market is closed on Monday for a national holiday. It will reopen on Tuesday.
On Friday, yen-based Tokyo precious metals futures ended mostly lower.

Benchmark August gold was two yen per gram lower at 1,335 yen. Benchmark August silver ended 3.9 yen per 10 grams lower at 177.3 yen. Benchmark August platinum was four yen per gram lower at 1,359 yen. Benchmark August palladium was flat at 428 yen.
